title: Quantum Elements' Constellation Wins TMCnet 2026 Quantum Computing Product Award
excerpt: Quantum Elements wins a TMCnet 2026 award for Constellation, a platform for designing and testing quantum systems before hardware runs.
content:
Insider Brief

  • Quantum Elements’ Constellation platform has been named a winner of TMCnet’s inaugural 2026 Quantum Computing Product of the Year Awards.
  • Constellation provides a hardware-aware development environment for designing, testing and analyzing quantum systems on classical computing infrastructure.
  • The platform supports quantum hardware teams in evaluating noise, error-correction strategies and decoder performance before hardware runs.

PRESS RELEASE — Quantum Elements, developers of software shortening the path to fault-tolerant quantum computing, today announced that its Constellation platform has been named a winner of TMCnet’z inaugural 2026 Quantum Computing Product of the Year Awards.

Constellation gives quantum teams a hardware-aware development environment, running on classical computer architecture, to design, test and analyze quantum systems before committing to hardware runs. It allows quantum hardware teams to understand noise, test error-correction strategies, and evaluate decoder performance. The technology builds digital twins for every quantum software layer and user persona.

“Constellation is bridging the gap between experimental hardware to fault-tolerant system design by giving development teams a faster, safer, and more repeatable way to validate ideas, improve designs, and prepare workflows for real-world deployment,” said Izhar Medalsy, co-founder and CEO of Quantum Elements. “We are honored by this recognition of the important role we are playing in advancing towards fault-tolerant quantum computers.”

“On behalf of TMCnet and our editors, I’m pleased to recognize Quantum Elements as a winner of the inaugural 2026 Quantum Computing Product of the Year Awards,” said Rich Tehrani, TMCnet’s CEO and Group Editor-in-Chief. “Constellation represents the kind of innovation that is helping move quantum computing forward—from extraordinary science toward technologies that organizations can access, develop and ultimately put to work. We congratulate Quantum Elements on this achievement and are proud to recognize it as part of the first class of Quantum Computing Product of the Year Award winners.”

The Quantum Computing Product of the Year Awards recognize outstanding products and solutions advancing the quantum computing ecosystem and helping move quantum applications and broader commercial adoption.

Winners of the 2026 Quantum Computing Product of the Year Awards are published on TMCnet.
